summary: The chat. The server can send messages and decide whether ordinary messages go to everyone automatically. A client can write as its player and show or hide the chat window.

sendToAll.summary: Sends a message to all players.

params.options: `author`, shown as the sender, and `color`, a packed colour number.

sendToAll.example: kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll('The market opens at dawn.', { author: 'Herald' });
sendToAll.exampleLua: kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll("The market opens at dawn.", { author = "Herald" })
sendToAll.exampleCs: Chat.SendToAll("The market opens at dawn.", new { author = "Herald" });

sendToPlayer.summary: Sends a message to one player. Nothing happens if they have left.
sendToPlayer.exampleLua: kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Only you can read this.", { author = "Whisper", color = kcds.math.Color.fromRGB(180, 180, 255) })
sendToPlayer.exampleCs: Chat.SendToPlayer(player, "Only you can read this.", new { author = "Whisper", color = Color.FromRGB(180, 180, 255) });

setChatRelay.summary: Turns the default relay on or off. When on, the default, each ordinary message goes to all players before playerChat fires. Turn it off to route chat yourself, for local chat, channels or mutes. Commands, which start with /, are never relayed.
setChatRelay.exampleLua:
local Chat, Events = kcds.core.Chat, kcds.core.Events

Chat.setChatRelay(false)
Events.on("playerChat", function(speaker, text)
  for _, listener in ipairs(kcds.players.Player.inRadius(speaker.position, 20)) do
    Chat.sendToPlayer(listener, text, { author = speaker.nickname })
  end
end)

relaysChat.summary: Whether the default relay is on.
relaysChat.exampleLua:
if kcds.core.Chat.relaysChat() then
  print("all players see all messages")
end

send.summary: Sends a message as the local player, as if typed. Text starting with / is a command.
send.example:
// client: a web page button sends a command
kcds.ui.Web.on(view, 'sit', () => kcds.core.Chat.send('/sit'));
send.exampleLua:
-- client: a web page button sends a command
kcds.ui.Web.on(view, "sit", function() return kcds.core.Chat.send("/sit") end)
send.exampleCs:
// client: a web page button sends a command
Web.On(view, "sit", () => Chat.Send("/sit"));

setUIVisible.summary: Shows or hides the chat window in this game. While it is hidden no line shows and the chat key (T) opens nothing: the press raises the client event `chatKey` instead, so your own chat window can open.

open.summary: Opens the chat input, like the player's chat key.
open.exampleLua:
-- client
kcds.ui.Key.bind("t", function() return kcds.core.Chat.open() end)

isOpen.summary: Whether the chat input is open.
isOpen.exampleLua:
-- client
if kcds.core.Chat.isOpen() then
  print("the player is typing")
end
